objective: Preallocate window projection result vectors from projection counts.

tasks.title: Preallocate window projection results
tasks.result: SELECT window projection precomputation now preallocates the per-projection result vector from the known projection count.

notes: Cargo/linker verification used an E: workspace temp directory because the default C:/TEMP drive was full.
Projection-column alignment, window function detection, and non-window projection behavior were kept unchanged.
